title: Harborline First-Upgrade Welcome Credit on Cloud 8 Upgrades of Web Hosting Plans
content:
Harborline offers a first-upgrade welcome credit on the Cloud 8 upgrade charge of a Web Hosting Plans plan, decided by the upgrade proration lines on the plan's billing history:

- a plan with no upgrade proration line at all receives USD 25.00;
- a plan whose upgrade proration lines all belong to earlier terms (none ends on the plan's current term end date) receives USD 10.00;
- a plan that already has an upgrade proration line in its current term receives no welcome credit.

**Decision table**

| Upgrade proration lines on the plan | Any of them ends on the current term end date | Welcome credit |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | USD 25.00 |
| one or more | no | USD 10.00 |
| one or more | yes | none |

**Example (hypothetical).** A plan upgraded once two terms ago, whose upgrade line ended on that earlier term's end date, and never since: USD 10.00. The same plan with a further upgrade line ending on its current term end date: no welcome credit.
